name: io.github.jkresearch8/domscout
title: domscout
description: domscout browser API as MCP tools: screenshots, Markdown extraction, structured data, DOM snapshots, page automation, and crawls.

environmentVariables.name: DOMSCOUT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A domscout API key from https://www.domscout.io/dashboard/api-keys. Every tool call is billed to the account that owns it.

environmentVariables.name: DOMSCOUT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API host. Only needed against a non-production deployment; omit it in normal use.

environmentVariables.name: DOMSCOUT_DOCS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the host the documentation resources are read from. It cannot be derived from DOMSCOUT_BASE_URL, because the API host serves no llms-full.txt.
